annotation_validation: 26 unique non-owner source hashes, in-bounds polygon geometry, and source-observed example coordinates checked. This validates annotation consistency only, not resulting masks.
appearance_brief_provenance: One concise English sentence per look, derived only from the displayed source sprite. Hair gathering/fall and visible neckline/shoulder/strap coverage are described; skin/hair color and identity variant axes are not changed.
hair_priority_provenance: Source-visible face/neck contours were reviewed independently at22x. Hair exclusions prevent brown cheek/jaw/neck shadows from being dyed as scalp hair; dedicated adult facial-hair supports follow actual visible beards. No mask pixel painting or threshold-derived boxes.

inner_arm_refinement_provenance.basis: Actual source-only geometry and visible continuity of exposed upper-arm skin in enlarged source grids, after independent tint inspection revealed the residual omission. No coverage threshold or measured box optimization was used.
